from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544646/attempts/cb2a11620c414603a21132bf1f3c6a84/system/state/workspace/programs/task-9b503eda.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(i for i in range(w) if all(row[i] == grid[0][i] for row in grid) and len({row[i] for row in grid}) == 1)
    if divider == 0 and len(set(grid[0])) == 1:
        # Horizontal separator.
        top, bottom = grid[:h//2], grid[h//2+1:]
        return [[2 if a and b else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom)]
    left_w, right_w = divider, w-divider-1
    n = min(left_w, right_w)
    return [[2 if row[c] and row[divider+1+c] else 0 for c in range(n)] for row in grid]
''')
# Test transform on given test
exec(p.read_text())
